operations.marker: /* v1.5.3 calendar day modal + booking cancellation */
operations.text:
/* v1.5.3 calendar day modal + booking cancellation */
.calendar-day-open{appearance:none;font:inherit;color:inherit;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;width:100%;border:0}.calendar-day-open.has-events{cursor:pointer}.calendar-day-open:active{transform:scale(.98)}.calendar-day-modal{border:0;padding:0;background:transparent;width:min(92vw,520px);max-height:82vh}.calendar-day-modal::backdrop{background:rgba(0,0,0,.48);backdrop-filter:blur(3px)}.calendar-day-sheet{background:var(--surface);color:inherit;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:24px;box-shadow:0 20px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.28);overflow:hidden}.calendar-day-sheet-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:12px;padding:18px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.calendar-day-sheet-head h2{margin:3px 0 0;font-size:21px}.calendar-modal-close{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--soft);color:inherit;width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:12px;font-size:25px;line-height:1;cursor:pointer}.calendar-day-sheet-body{display:grid;gap:10px;padding:14px;max-height:62vh;overflow:auto}.calendar-modal-booking{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:13px;border-radius:16px;background:var(--soft);border:1px solid var(--line);text-decoration:none;color:inherit}.calendar-modal-booking>div{display:grid;gap:3px;min-width:0}.calendar-modal-booking small{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}.calendar-event-preview{display:flex!important;text-decoration:none!important}.cancelled-dot{background:#8a8f98!important}.cancelled-pill{background:#e7e8eb!important;color:#555!important;border-color:#d4d6da!important}.calendar-event.cancelled,.calendar-cancelled{opacity:.58;filter:grayscale(.35)}.booking-admin-card{display:grid;gap:8px}.booking-actions-v141{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px}.booking-actions-v141 form,.booking-actions-v141 .btn{width:100%}.cancelled-booking-v141{opacity:.88}@media(max-width:420px){.calendar-day-modal{width:94vw}.calendar-modal-booking{align-items:flex-start}.calendar-modal-booking .pill{font-size:8px}.booking-actions-v141{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

sql: ALTER TABLE sessions MODIFY status ENUM('scheduled','active','closed','cancelled') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'scheduled'
